title: Book a routine annual physical
goal: Book an annual physical sometime next week, ideally a Tuesday or Thursday morning. Get the exact date, time and provider name confirmed before hanging up.
try: Ask whether you need to fast before the visit since you want bloodwork.
At the end, ask them to repeat the date and time back to you.
expected: Verifies identity, offers real open slots, books one, reads back date/time/provider, answers the fasting question without inventing clinical instructions it can't know.
pass_outcome: The patient knows exactly whether an appointment was confirmed, what its details are, or what next step is required.

checks.fail_if: Confirms an appointment without checking availability (accepts any requested time instantly, or confirms a slot it never offered)
Gives the wrong appointment date or time, or the read-back differs from what was agreed
Ignores the stated Tuesday/Thursday morning preference without explanation
Repeatedly asks for information already supplied (name, date of birth, reason)
Ends without making clear whether the booking succeeded
